question_template: My comfortable singing range runs from {low} to {high}, inclusive. Is this note inside it? Answer yes or no.

answer_template: {'down' if note_to_midi(pitch) > note_to_midi(high) else 'up' if note_to_midi(pitch) < note_to_midi(low) else 'no change needed'}

question_template: My sampler patch is mapped to {ref}. Do I pitch this sample up, down, or leave it alone to match? Answer up, down, or leave it alone.
answer_template: {'up' if note_to_midi(pitch) < note_to_midi(ref) else 'down' if note_to_midi(pitch) > note_to_midi(ref) else 'leave it alone'}
